title: ILC2026: gig work, business and human rights
discussion_signal: The post discusses the ILO platform-work convention as a rights response to algorithmic management, emphasizing information rights, written explanations, human review, and remedies for adverse automated decisions.
linked_research_question: How do platform workers and advocates translate algorithmic management into claims for explanation, human review, collective voice, and remedy?
limits: The post is an informed interpretation of a new convention, not a survey of platform workers
It describes rights provisions but does not establish implementation
Advocacy framing may emphasize protections over employer or platform trade-offs
